recommendation_before_coding.6_v3_o1_root_cause: measure_v3 lets ANY jamb record consume wall-path length: the overlap of every jamb record is subtracted from each edge before classification, and the record is only afterwards tested for 'physical'. A non-physical opening-side record (CONTINUOUS_WALL_FACE, H518 at the M.B.ROOM / DRESS passage) therefore removed 0.15 of real wall face that no class then counted.
recommendation_before_coding.7_generic_v4_rule: Separate OPENING_SIDE relations from PHYSICAL_JAMB surfaces. A path span may be consumed ONLY by a jamb record that is physical by positive source evidence (a drawn cap / band end CAPPED / ALIGNED_FREE_END / OPENING_JAMB of an ESTABLISHED band, or a door / glazed-door strip reveal side); a non-physical record is an annotation and never shortens an edge; a topology closure is classified by its own sources and never consumes or creates wall. Every edge length is conserved per site: wall + column + obstacle + window continuity + physical jamb overlap + excluded + withheld = boundary length (checked, not assumed). Trade eligibility is applied after geometry: door / sliding-door jambs = 0, doorless physical jambs counted once.
recommendation_before_coding.8_topology_or_trade: Trade measurement only. No TS01 input changes; the topology digest must stay the R8.16 digest.
recommendation_before_coding.9_freeze_and_blind: YES: V4 changes the arithmetic of a frozen, published shadow method -> V4 policy + QORTUBA-NEW-SKIRTING-METHOD@v3 + synthetic tests -> freeze -> commit -> blind Qortuba skirting run -> commit -> only then compare with R8.16.
recommendation_before_coding.10_wall_face_engine_now: BEGIN the PHYSICAL layer this round (after the V4 blind run), with its own freeze and blind run: vertical surfaces from the V4-classified spans (wall / column / obstacle faces), openings with their own height authority (US-06 full area), lintel bands over closed openings, passage head faces, reveal surfaces (source depth first, US-07 fallback), a per-site reconciliation and a double-count guard. Trade publication only where every authority exists: WALL_TILE in the wet / service rooms can be computed (3.20 m owner fact, QP-21 / QP-22 / QP-12 opening heights, sill fact v2 for containment); PLASTER and PAINT stay BLOCKED on the dry-room wall height of the new revision; wet-room reveal treatment stays OPEN.
recommendation_before_coding.11_waterproofing: DEFER to R8.18.
